definition_zh: 同时描述分数阶力学关系和参数随机性的模型。
usage_overview: 随机分数阶导数模型可用于橡胶支座建模，将分数阶黏弹元件与随机参数结合，在浮置板轨道隔振分析中同时描述支座的黏弹性及参数不确定性。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: In this work, a stochastic fractional derivative model is proposed for simulating the dynamic behavior of rubber bearings in floating slab tracks.
The characteristics and advantages of the stochastic fractional derivative model with deterministic parameters are illustrated by comparing the results with the conventional Kelvin model.
